verdict.rationale: The only API evidence is the ES|QL REST query endpoint, which supports output formats, filters, time zone and locale parameters, so programmatic querying of telemetry is documented. Nothing shows that UI features such as dashboards, SLOs, alerting rules, cases, Fleet or synthetics are fully available through an API, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the tested paths. missing for 10: documented API parity across UI features (alerts/rules, SLOs, cases, dashboards, Fleet, synthetics), a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of UI-API parity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
